answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a kernel for Sybil resistance in AI economies by anchoring identity to collateralized capital rather than ephemeral network presence. An attacker cannot simply spawn a sparrow-like swarm of identities because each node requires a locked stake of tokens, turning the ivory tower of abstract influence into a tangible financial hurdle. The cost to the adversary scales linearly with the network value, rendering mass identity forgery economically prohibitive as the underlying asset appreciates.
